pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.e.e1: Gaffer, word is you asked about me. What would you have in mind for me?
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.e.e2: I heard about your interest and wanted to ask you myself how serious it is.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.e.e3: My agent says your club is interested. I want to hear it from you, not from the papers.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.a.a1: Yes, I have followed you for a long time and see you in an important role with us.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.a.a2: Before I say more: what do you have in mind for the contract and its length?
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.a.a3: The clubs talk about the fee, that is not up to the two of us.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.a.a4: First I want to understand whether you still feel at home at your current club.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.a.a5: We have decided otherwise. I am not planning with you, and I wanted to tell you honestly.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.r.r1: {b.gut} That is an honest word, and it pleases me a lot.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.r.r2: {b.neutral} I will think about it and get back to you through my agent.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.r.r3: {b.schlecht} That is not how I pictured this conversation.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.x.x1: The talk was open, and {name} wants to pursue the matter.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.x.x2: Both sides leave it open for now, {name} will get back through the agent.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.x.x3: The talk went badly, {name} feels not taken seriously.
pool.sondierung_erstkontakt.x.x4: You turned {name} down, the approach is over.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.e.e1: This is the agent of {name}. We should talk about salary, length and role, if you are serious.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.e.e2: My player {name} is open to a talk, but first I need your ideas about the contract.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.e.e3: Before we go on, I would like to know what terms you have in mind for {name}.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.a.a1: We offer a fair salary, a long term and a clear role in the team.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.a.a2: Tell me your player's expectations first, then we will see where we stand.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.a.a3: Our terms are set: a salary within our squad's structure and a role he earns.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.a.a4: We will settle the details once the club has agreed, please be patient.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.a.a5: These demands blow our budget, we are ending the talks.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.r.r1: {b.gut} That is an offer we can work with.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.r.r2: {b.neutral} I will pass that on to {name} and call again.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.r.r3: {b.schlecht} We will not get far with an attitude like that.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.x.x1: The terms are set for now, {name}'s agent is satisfied.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.x.x2: The agent of {name} is checking your ideas and will call back.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.x.x3: The agent of {name} is annoyed and demands a new offer.
pool.sondierung_vertragswunsch.x.x4: You broke off the talks about {name}.
pool.sondierung_abloese.e.e1: The club of {name} will not sell cheaply. How do you feel about a fee?
pool.sondierung_abloese.e.e2: I hear you are thinking about a fee. My player wants to know whether that is just talk.
pool.sondierung_abloese.e.e3: There is movement on the fee, so I would like to know your position before I talk to the club.
pool.sondierung_abloese.a.a1: We are ready to pay an appropriate fee if the club stays reasonable.
pool.sondierung_abloese.a.a2: What exactly does the club expect? Then I can check it with our sporting director.
pool.sondierung_abloese.a.a3: Our sporting director will handle that, he will contact the club directly.
pool.sondierung_abloese.a.a4: Let us wait first and see how things develop at the club.
pool.sondierung_abloese.a.a5: We will not pay a cent above market value, otherwise we look elsewhere.
pool.sondierung_abloese.r.r1: {b.gut} With that I can go to the club and negotiate.
pool.sondierung_abloese.r.r2: {b.neutral} I will sound out the club and let you know.
pool.sondierung_abloese.r.r3: {b.schlecht} Then the club need not even bother to negotiate.
pool.sondierung_abloese.x.x1: The fee is under discussion, the path to the club of {name} is open.
pool.sondierung_abloese.x.x2: The fee stays unsettled for now, the agent of {name} asks the club.
pool.sondierung_abloese.x.x3: The agent of {name} finds your attitude on the fee outrageous.
pool.sondierung_abloese.x.x4: You withdrew on the fee, the approach is over.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.titel: Does he want to move at all?
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.e.e1: I am honest, gaffer: I do not know yet whether I want to leave my club.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.e.e2: Your interest honours me, but I have family and friends here. Why should you be the better choice?
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.e.e3: I am thinking about whether a move makes sense for my career. Explain your plan to me.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.a.a1: I understand your doubts. I want you to feel at home with us, not only needed.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.a.a2: What would keep you at your current club, and what is missing there?
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.a.a3: With us you would get a fixed role and a development you can follow.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.a.a4: The offer does not last forever, decide soon, or I will take someone else.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.a.a5: If you are unsure, it is better we drop it and go our separate ways.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.r.r1: {b.gut} I had not seen it that way, that helps me.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.r.r2: {b.neutral} I still need time to sleep on it.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.r.r3: {b.schlecht} You will not get me with pressure.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.x.x1: {name} seems more open to a move than before.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.x.x2: {name} has not decided yet and wants to sleep on it.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.x.x3: {name} feels pressured and keeps his distance.
pool.sondierung_wechselwunsch.x.x4: You part on friendly terms, {name} will probably stay with his club.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.e.e1: The contract of {name} runs out in {monate} months. We are listening around, and you are high on the list.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.e.e2: In {monate} months {name} is a free agent. Whoever talks now has a head start, which is why I am calling you.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.e.e3: My player will be free soon, and I would like to know beforehand what you would offer him once the contract ends.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.a.a1: We offer him a pre-contract right now, as soon as the rules allow it.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.a.a2: What does he ask for once the contract ends, and who else is talking to him?
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.a.a3: We let time work for us and will call when it gets concrete.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.a.a4: We only negotiate if he commits by the end of the season.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.a.a5: We plan differently in the long run. For {name} there is currently no place with us.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.r.r1: {b.gut} That is a strong signal, my player will be glad.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.r.r2: {b.neutral} I will keep you on my screen and call again.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.r.r3: {b.schlecht} Then we go to those who show more respect.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.x.x1: The agent of {name} sees you as first contact after the contract ends.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.x.x2: The agent of {name} waits and keeps in touch with you and other clubs.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.x.x3: The agent of {name} turns to other clubs.
pool.sondierung_vertragsende.x.x4: You are no longer interested, the agent of {name} looks elsewhere.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.titel: Other clubs are in the race
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.e.e1: I want to be open: there are other interested parties for {name}. How serious is your intention?
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.e.e2: Two other clubs have asked me. If you want him, you must declare yourself soon.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.e.e3: {name} is being courted and I must prioritise. Why should he join you?
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.a.a1: We are seriously interested and ready to act quickly if it fits.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.a.a2: We offer playing time, a well-drilled team and a plan for his development.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.a.a3: The others are surely nice too, but we have the longer breath.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.a.a4: We do not let ourselves be pressured and we outbid nobody.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.a.a5: If so many clubs are bidding, we withdraw.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.r.r1: {b.gut} Then I will put you on the shortlist.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.r.r2: {b.neutral} I will compare all the offers and let you know.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.r.r3: {b.schlecht} Then you are no longer an option for us.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.x.x1: {name} and his agent take you seriously, you are on the shortlist.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.x.x2: The agent of {name} keeps collecting offers and will get in touch.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.x.x3: The agent of {name} strikes you off the list.
pool.sondierung_konkurrenz.x.x4: You withdrew from the bidding for {name}.
